# GCM Safety Nets - Comprehensive Technical & Service Documentation (LLMs Full)

# GCM Safety Nets - Hyderabad & Telangana

> Leading provider of professional safety nets, anti-bird netting, invisible grills, sports netting, and ceiling cloth drying hangers across Hyderabad and Secunderabad. ISO certified, 15+ years experience, 5-year warranty, same-day installation.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity**: GCM Safety Nets (GCM Enterprises)
- **Primary Website**: https://www.gcmsafetynets.in
- **Headquarters**: Plot No 42, H.No 2-3-512/A, B.S. Maktha, Begumpet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500016
- **Customer Support & Dispatch**: +91 99123 99224 / +91 99123 99227
- **Official Email**: gcmsafetynets@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday - Sunday, 07:00 AM - 09:00 PM IST
- **Turnaround Time**: Same-day site inspection & 2-4 hour installation
- **Warranty**: 5 Years to 10 Years Comprehensive Replacement Warranty

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Balcony Safety Nets**: High-grade Garware nylon and monofilament nets engineered to prevent accidental falls of children, pets, and objects. Breaking load capacity exceeding 120-150 kg.
- **Anti-Bird & Pigeon Netting**: UV-stabilized transparent & white pigeon nets (25mm to 30mm mesh). 100% humane, zero injury to birds, keeps balconies, ducts, and AC units clean from pigeon droppings.
- **Balcony Invisible Grills**: Marine-grade 316 stainless steel high-tensile wire rope (2mm - 3mm thickness, nylon-coated) with 400+ kg tensile load. Unobstructed panoramic city views with maximum fall security.
- **Box Cricket & Practice Nets**: Heavy-duty HDPE braided sports netting (1.5mm - 3.0mm thickness, 40mm mesh) with complete structural column framework, overhead cabling, and turf integration.
- **Ceiling Cloth Drying Hangers**: Space-saving pulley-operated 6-pipe and 4-pipe rust-proof stainless steel drying systems mounted to ceiling slabs.
- **Duct Area & Industrial Safety Nets**: Large-scale debris, fall-arrest, and duct-closure netting for high-rise residential societies, factories, and commercial complexes.

## Technical Specifications & Engineering Standards

### 1. Balcony & Pigeon Safety Nets
- **Raw Material**: 100% Virgin High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) / High-Tenacity Nylon 6 (Garware Technical Fibres)
- **Yarn Thickness**: 0.8 mm, 1.0 mm, 1.2 mm, 1.5 mm, 2.0 mm, 2.5 mm
- **Mesh Size**: 25 mm x 25 mm, 30 mm x 30 mm (Pigeons & Small Birds); 40 mm x 40 mm, 50 mm x 50 mm (Children & Pets)
- **Breaking Strength**: 28 kgf to 160 kgf per twine; cumulative mesh impact resistance up to 150 kg dynamic load
- **UV Resistance**: Masterbatch UV stabilizers rated for 500+ KLY (guaranteed 5+ years against solar brittleness in Hyderabad)
- **Fasteners**: Marine-grade AISI 304/316 Stainless Steel round hooks, 8mm nylon rawl plugs, high-tension nylon perimeter border rope

### 2. Invisible Grills
- **Cable Composition**: AISI 316 Grade Marine Stainless Steel Wire Rope (7x7 / 7x19 strand configuration)
- **Core Diameter**: 2.0 mm & 2.5 mm high-tensile core with transparent DuPont nylon/Teflon protective sheath (prevents rust, dust, and finger cuts)
- **Breaking Load**: 400+ kg tensile breaking load per cable strand
- **Gap Spacing**: 2 inches (50 mm) or 3 inches (75 mm) vertical/horizontal spacing
- **Track System**: Heavy extruded anodized aluminum H-tracks with internal locking cap system and anti-tamper security screws

### 3. Sports & Cricket Practice Nets
- **Material**: Multi-strand braided HDPE UV treated yarn
- **Mesh Configuration**: 40 mm square mesh (standard cricket ball containment), 25 mm (golf/multi-ball)
- **Overhead Tensioning**: 4mm / 6mm galvanized steel wire ropes with commercial turnbuckles, D-shackles, and wire rope clamps

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Knowledge Base)

### Q1: How much does safety net installation cost in Hyderabad?
A: Professional installation by GCM Safety Nets starts from ₹18 to ₹28 per square foot for premium Garware nylon or HDPE balcony safety nets. Stainless steel invisible grills start from ₹95 to ₹140 per square foot. Doorstep site inspection and measurements anywhere in Hyderabad are 100% free with no obligation.

### Q2: How quickly can GCM Safety Nets install nets in Hyderabad?
A: We provide same-day inspection and installation across all 188 Hyderabad and Secunderabad localities. Standard balcony net installation is typically completed within 1 to 2 hours by certified technicians without damaging walls or tiles.

### Q3: Do pigeon nets harm birds?
A: No. GCM Safety Nets uses humane 25mm–30mm square mesh netting that forms a physical barrier preventing pigeons from entering or nesting. Birds cannot get trapped or injured.

### Q4: What is the warranty provided?
A: We issue an official 5-Year Replacement Warranty Card covering net tears, UV degradation, and hook loosening.

### Q5: What is the phone number to book safety net installation near me?
A: You can reach GCM Safety Nets directly at +91 99123 99224 or WhatsApp +91 99123 99224 for immediate technician dispatch.
